channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Video shows Gaza teen fisherman before Israeli forces killed him at sea
item.description: Mohammad Abu Giab was a 15-year-old fisherman from Gaza that was shot dead by Israeli forces off Deir el-Balah.

item.title: Iran says 18 targets hit across US bases, Strait of Hormuz closed
item.description: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard Corps says it hit 18 targets at US bases in Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan.

item.title: Three Indian sailors killed in US strike on oil tanker
item.description: A US strike on an oil tanker accused of transporting Iranian oil has killed three Indian sailors.

item.title: UN watchdog demands Iran provide information on nuclear stockpile
item.description: Iran slams US-backed IAEA resolution as 'politically motivated' and warns it could complicate ceasefire talks.

item.title: US releases video of warship firing missiles in strikes on Iran
item.description: Video released by US Central Command shows what the military says are ‘self-defence’ strikes on Iranian targets.

item.title: Thailand court sentences two men to death for 2015 Bangkok bombing
item.description: The August 2015 attack at the popular Erawan shrine in Bangkok's commercial heart killed 20 and wounded over 100 more.

item.title: Iran war day 104: Iran attacks US bases, closes strait after Trump strikes
item.description: Iran closes Strait of Hormuz, launches retaliatory strikes on US bases in Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan after US attacks.

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes across Middle East for second day in a row
item.description: Iran says it responded to US strikes by targeting American assets in Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain, which reported damage to its capital city overnight.

item.title: Vance says Israeli PM Netanyahu 'has got some things wrong'
item.description: The US vice-president says the Israeli leader "aggressively asserts" his country's interests, but they do not always align with those of the US.

item.title: Four days of extreme rain killed 7% of world's rarest orangutans, study says
item.description: Climate change-induced weather events are pushing orangutan populations to extinction, says a study.
